findings.issue: Required Jekyll build and rendered desktop/mobile verification were not completed: Ruby, Bundler, Jekyll, and Docker were unavailable, so no _site HTML or browser check exists.
findings.consequence: The review cannot establish that the changed Liquid compiles and produces the required summary-only homepage, or that the representative detail page and mobile layout work in rendered output.
findings.correction: In a Ruby/Bundler-enabled environment, run bundle install and bundle exec jekyll build, inspect _site/index.html and the representative generated post page for the homepage/detail boundary, then perform and record desktop and mobile-width checks for clipping or horizontal overflow.
